sources.entry: Whisper ASR Webservice | Speech-to-text API powered by OpenAI Whisper

summary.one_liner: A Dockerized REST web service that wraps OpenAI Whisper, Faster Whisper, and WhisperX for speech-to-text transcription with a Swagger UI.
summary.what_it_does: Whisper ASR Box runs speech recognition models behind an HTTP API. It supports three engines selectable via the ASR_ENGINE variable: openai_whisper, faster_whisper, and whisperx. Output can be returned as text, JSON, VTT, SRT, or TSV. It offers word-level timestamps, voice activity detection (VAD) filtering, and speaker diarization when using WhisperX. FFmpeg is used for a wide range of audio and video input formats. The service can unload models after an idle timeout, and it ships with Swagger documentation for trying endpoints in the browser. Docker images are provided for CPU and GPU (CUDA) use.
use_cases: transcribing audio or video files to SRT or VTT subtitles
speaker diarization of meetings with WhisperX
adding transcription to an app via REST calls
notable: Three interchangeable ASR engines behind one REST API
Speaker diarization available with WhisperX engine
Configurable model unloading after idle timeout (MODEL_IDLE_TIMEOUT)
Separate CPU and CUDA Docker images and Poetry extras
caveats: GPU use requires Docker with --gpus all and a CUDA-capable setup
Speaker diarization is only listed for the WhisperX engine
Full documentation is referenced by a link not included in the README text
